title: Decode still images and image sequences through the shared source-fill path

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (GP104BM), Vulkan validation layer enabled
environment.ocio_config: docs/evidence/issue12-view.ocio (the established native media verification config; without it the viewer reports "color config: no config given and the OCIO environment variable is not set" and shows an empty viewer)
environment.capture: cosmic-screenshot --interactive=false --save-dir <dir> on the Wayland session; the full-output PNG was cropped to the Nemo window (1280x630 at offset 235,195) and the uncropped originals were deleted

fixtures.note: Real files created with ffmpeg 6.1.1; hashes identify the exact bytes used. They are not committed (produced on demand).
commands: ffmpeg -y -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=gray:s=8x6 -frames:v 1 -pix_fmt gray gray.png
printf 'not an image at all' > corrupt.exr

limitations: Captures were inspected through the vision model, not by a human; they are intermediate evidence pending owner review.
Frames were selected at launch (--frame); no interactive frame stepping or physical-pointer gesture was performed.
The app window is 1280x630 of a 1920x1080 output; no narrow-layout or theme variation was captured (this task has no UI design scope).
Full-output screenshots were cropped to the window and the originals deleted; a window-only capture API was not available.

prototype_conformance: Not applicable: issue #62 is a backend/runtime media decode slice with no panel presentation change. The observable surfaces are headless evaluation and the existing single-viewer --source path, both exercised above.
